# my-website.cloud

> my-website.cloud designs, builds and hosts websites for growing businesses, then looks after them every month. One team, one monthly plan, with a written quote before any work starts.

Key facts:
- What we do: website design and build, managed hosting, ongoing care, search foundations, domains and email, forms and automation.
- How it is priced: a written quote up front, then one monthly plan after launch.
- Ownership: the client owns their domain, content and site.
- Contact: hello@my-website.cloud

## Pages
- [Home](https://my-website.cloud/): overview of what we do and who it is for
- [Services](https://my-website.cloud/services.html): the six services, the monthly plan and common questions
- [Work](https://my-website.cloud/work.html): recent live websites
- [Approach](https://my-website.cloud/about.html): how a project runs in four stages, what to expect, and FAQs
- [Contact](https://my-website.cloud/contact.html): how to start a project and get a written quote
